'''Galladinium Galactic Exports''' was a major technology supply company. Led by the [[Duros/Legends|Duros]] [[Unidentified Galladinium president|Galladinium]] at some point from [[50 BBY/Legends|50 BBY]] to [[47 BBY/Legends|47 BBY]]<ref name="Date" /> on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Lenthalis]], Galladinium Galactic Exports worked itself into one of the [[Galaxy/Legends|galaxy's]] premier corporations. Their inventory was made known throughout the galaxy via the [[Standard year/Legends|yearly]] publication, ''[[Galladinium's Galactic Datalog of Fantastic Technology]]''.

{{Company-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Galladinium Galactic Exports was first introduced in the real-world supplement to [[West End Games]]' [[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]], ''[[Galladinium's Fantastic Technology]]'', as an in-universe technology corporation.
